text: Appeal of Dangerous Dog Order issued, September 27, 2022, Appeal DDRT2023-13.

The Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal: 1. Denied the request for a deferral of Appeal DDRT2023-13 to another meeting date. 2. Confirmed the determination of a dangerous dog and directed that the conditions of the Order remain in effect, and that the Tribunal forward the reasons for this decision to Kiano Vafaeian and the Executive Director, Municipal Licensing and Standards on or before September 29, 2023.
